name: appbuilder-quality-check
description: Code-quality review tooling for Adobe App Builder projects (engine + CLI + MCP server + GitHub Action + aio CLI plugin).

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of fs.readdirSync('packages',{withFileTypes:true}))if(d.isDirectory())for(const t of ['dist','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'])fs.rmSync('packages/'+d.name+'/'+t,{recursive:true,force:true})"
